policy: Only high/critical findings with no upstream fixed version may be listed. Any new, changed, stale, or fixable package finding fails the gate and requires re-triage.
common_mitigations: Development-only loopback exposure; uid/gid 999 from PID 1; no Linux capabilities; no-new-privileges; read-only root filesystem; only bounded tmpfs and database volume writable.

allowed_unfixed.rationale: Debian publishes no fixed version. The vulnerable terminal parser is not used by the PostgreSQL server request path; psql is retained for local health/administration only.
